entries.text: The tallest trees and stalagmites lose half their height, and TzHaar's fences are gone
Fences, graves and toadstool beds stand in groups, and TzHaar's banner is gone
Every region stands twice as many kinds of tree, rock and ruin, and Karamja's floor turns warm green
Every region gets a smoother, more varied ground, and rough tiles stop drawing a grid
A plot hides the tree it stands on, and the tree comes back when you move it
Regions get varied ground, still water and props that stand on their shadows
Every region stands its own trees, rocks and ruins on the board
Regions get their own ground texture, flowing water and lava pools you can fish
Twelve new monsters, so every region fields at least five of its own
Party Pete dances by his balloons on the ground and leaves once they are all popped
Plant a carried seed straight from the inventory
The Tool Leprechaun tends your slowest herb so it is ready a wave sooner
Dr Jekyll turns up with a high-level herb for your inventory
Random events get likelier with every wave that passes without one, and the odds reset when one turns up
Sergeant Damien replaces Rick Turpentine, and a click drills every tower up 2 levels
The Strange Plant says what it grew, an Overload or a high-level herb seed you can sow for free
The Drunken Dwarf's kebab and the genie's lamp go in your inventory, and rubbing the lamp gains 3 levels in Hunter, Herblore or Fishing
Hans tells you something about your run, a Hunting expert comes to re-set your most worn trap, and Party Pete leaves balloons to pop
Visitors between waves show what a click pays, float it off the board when you take it, and the Collection Log totals what each one has given you
Fish heal on an even ladder: shrimps 1 life, trout 2, lobster 3, shark 4 and manta ray 5
Hovering a potion sums up what it does in icons, and the Herblore bench shows the herbs and gold each brew needs
A fish's hover card always shows its full heal in green, and only the lives it would leave you at turn red when you are already full
The black demon dies with the long demon roar instead of a smaller demon's short cry
Hovering a fish previews the lives it gives back, and hovering gear sums up its stats in icons
Dragging an item in the inventory or loot bag carries a see-through copy of it under the cursor
The interface opens at 100%, or the largest size your screen fits, instead of a few percent under it
The loot bag's stat block no longer jumps while you hover its tower list
The inventory menu lists every potion a herb brews and asks before drinking a potion still running
Hunter traps pay a third more XP for every firing
Picking up a trap refunds its price by the charges it has left
Snares can grip the same enemy again once it breaks free, and newcomers still come first
Notices stay up long enough to read, and longer ones stay up longer
Notices above the prayer bar are a third larger
The red flash from a Zamorak brew drunk while paused fades instead of staying on the board
A life won back washes the board green, the way a leak washes it red
Every life you win back pops on the lives orb
Eating food or drinking a brew shows the lives you gained, not a flash like a hit
Hovering a monster in the wave roster shows its card over the potion timers
Opening the wave roster pushes the potion timers down instead of covering them
A trap springs on what walked over it, not on where it landed
